messages:
maria.chen: Planning a longer soak this weekend — starting Sat 01:00 PT for ~6h. Goal: full replay + mixed bursts, validate KV cache eviction and long-tail p99 behavior, and exercise model routing under sustained load.

sam: I can cover 01:00-03:00. Who can take 03:00-05:00 and 05:00-07:00?

alex.k: I can do 03:00-05:00; will be remote but available on Slack.

oliver: I'll cover 05:00-07:00. Please publish the exact run commands and abort criteria.

maria.chen: Run plan (staggered): first 3h steady replay with k6, then 3h mixed with periodic locust spikes to hit auth and model hot paths.

# k6 steady replay (sampled trace) - longer duration
k6 run --vus 300 --duration 3h replay-steady.js --out json=artifacts/k6-weekend-steady.json

# locust intermittent spikes - run in parallel, headless, step load
locust -f locustfile.py --headless -u 800 -r 100 --run-time 3h --csv=artifacts/locust-weekend
# additional short bursts scheduled via cron every 30m:
python scripts/schedule_burst.py --count 6 --size 600 --interval 1800

Upload artifacts to s3://redwood-ci/soak-runs/2212345678/ (create subdirs per job).

ekaterina: profiling checklist:
- enable pprof on runtime nodes (6060) and metrics exporter (9090)
- run 30s and 60s pprof samples for long-run comparison
- capture `vmstat 1 3600`, `iostat -x 30`, `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv -l 30`
- collect flamegraphs for worker processes every hour

sam: I'll wire up a systemd slice to stream sar/iostat to /tmp/soak-metrics/ and rsync to a central capture host every 20m.

oliver: Abort guardrails (please configure in the soak controller):
- auto-abort if p95 > 1.2s for 4 consecutive 5m windows
- abort if sustained error rate > 0.8% for 15m
- abort if GPU mem pressure > 92% for 10m

rachel: Routing policy request: enable fallback-lite route if retry rate > 150/min, ramp to 10% traffic over 5m, cap at 25%. We need to monitor quality diffs on a small prompt set.

maria.chen: routing policy staged: primary -> fallback-lite (threshold 150 retries/min, ramp 5m, cap 25%). devops-bot will emit events to #eng-runtime-alerts.

devops-bot: Routing policy created: primary -> fallback-lite (threshold: 150 retries/min, ramp: 5m, cap: 25%). Webhooks set to #eng-runtime-alerts.

alex.k: Code review ping: PR #4860 updates the k6 harness to rotate API keys and write metadata files with run-id. Need approvals before 23:30 so scheduler can pick it up. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/replay-harness/pull/4860

tj: I'll review now and leave comments.

ekaterina: pprof capture commands (examples):
```
curl -sS http://<node>:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30 > artifacts/pprof-<node>-30s-$(date +%s).pb
curl -sS http://<node>:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=60 > artifacts/pprof-<node>-60s-$(date +%s).pb
# convert for flamegraph upload
go tool pprof -raw artifacts/pprof-<node>-60s-*.pb > artifacts/pprof-<node>-raw.pb
```
and schedule hourly flamegraph generation.

sam: merged PR #4860 at 22:40 and deployed the scheduler. First k6 steady job scheduled for 01:05.

devops-bot: Soak run scheduled: k6 job id b9f4, locust job id l7c2 9 start time 2026-03-21T01:05:00Z 9 artifacts path s3://redwood-ci/soak-runs/2212345678/ 9 posting to #eng-runtime-alerts.

maria.chen: Reminder: disable TRACE level request dumps and any heavy debug logging by 00:30. Keep sampling traces but no full request bodies.

oliver: noted. I'll sweep logging configs at 00:45.

sam: first 30m looks fine — p95 ~380ms, errors 0.03%. System metrics stable.

ekaterina: uploading pprof hourly tarballs to S3: s3://redwood-ci/soak-runs/2212345678/pprof/

alex.k: saw a short spike at 02:14 to p95=1.3s; controller did not auto-abort because it was a single 5m window. Filing INC-2410 to track.

rachel: fallback-lite engaged at 02:14 for ~9m, peaked at 3.5% of inference traffic routed. Running quality checks on canary prompts now.

maria.chen: please add any quality deltas to a regression ticket if metric drift > 0.7 BLEU-equivalent or other agreed metric. We'll triage Monday 09:30 if regressions show.

tj: confirmed burst spikes triggered temporary GC pauses on worker-4; attached flamegraph in the S3 artifacts.

oliver: I've reconciled logs, looks like a rare auth token refresh issue triggered upstream retries; we've pushed a mitigation to reduce retry floods for now.

sam: post-run handback checklist (complete before leaving):
- summarize p95/p99 vs baseline and paste numbers here
- upload all artifacts and link them in thread (pprof, sar, iostat, flamegraphs, k6/locust csv)
- create regression ticket if thresholds exceeded and tag owners
- short status post to #eng-runtime with :white_check_mark: or :warning:

maria.chen: thanks all. tagging the on-call rota: @sam (01:00-03:00), @alex.k (03:00-05:00), @oliver (05:00-07:00). Drop any follow-ups here and we'll fold into the runbook. Good luck everyone :rocket:
